title: Configuration from several sources
description:
Combine settings from defaults, a file and the command line, where later sources win.

```
port = 8080 (command line)
host = localhost (defaults)
debug = true (file)
```
hints: Keep a `Dictionary<string, (string Value, string Source)>` and overwrite entries source by source (lesson 6.03).
requirements: Sources are dictionaries of key to value; build the final settings by layering them in order.
Remember where each value came from and print it.
Command-line arguments look like `--port=8080`; ignore anything else.
A typed `Get<T>(string key, T fallback)` converts with `Convert.ChangeType` and returns the fallback on failure.
stretch: Add environment variables as a third source with a prefix: `APP_PORT` becomes `port`.
